_comment: Shared by tests/knowledge-secret-drift.test.ts (JavaScript patterns) and supabase/proposed/tests/0012_knowledge_secret_check.pglite.mjs (database trigger). Secret-shaped strings are stored as parts and joined at test time so the repository holds no literal credential-shaped text. All values are synthetic. 'js' is the id the application screen must report ('none' = nothing); 'db' is the id the 0012 trigger must report (null = accepted). 'js_raw' is used when the application would see different text than the database (it normalizes first).

cases.name: key after a non-ASCII letter still counts
key glued to a preceding ASCII letter is not a key
key split by a zero-width space (database removes it; the application normalizes elsewhere)
key split by a control character
ordinary procedure text
parts: Refunds over 500 dollars need a second approver before payment.

cases.name: short sk- prefix in a stock-keeping sentence
parts: Use the sk-1 prefix for stock keeping units in the catalogue.

cases.name: mentions of token formats without a token
parts: A jwt looks like three dotted segments and starts with the letters ey.

cases.name: short ghp_ prefix
parts: p_ marks a personal access token.

cases.name: airline code
parts: IA is not an airline code we use in the procedure.

cases.name: password assignment (application only)
parts: The wifi password is hunter22 for guests.
